# Coverage taxonomy — K ∧ E ∧ T

A leaf is *done* only when all three hold:

| Leg | Meaning | Source |
|---|---|---|
| **K** | the knowledge corpus teaches it | a `skills/_source/*.md` topic names the AOT type (or the `generate` subcommand) |
| **E** | an eval case proves it | a case in `eval/cases/` produces it and has a reviewed (non-pending) golden |
| **T** | the tool builds it | a `generate` subcommand emits it |

Every column is derived — families from `ObjectTypeRegistry`, capabilities from
`GenerateSurface`, E from the case catalog, K from the embedded corpus — so this
file cannot claim coverage that no longer exists. Regenerate with
`d365fo eval coverage --write`; CI runs `--check`.
